question: The average runs scored by a batsman in 23 matches is 43. In the next 10 matches, the batsman scored an average of 14 runs. Find his average runs scored (rounded off to two decimal places) in all the 33 matches.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume the base average is 14 (from the 10 matches).

Deviation of the first 23 matches = 43 − 14 = +29 runs per match.

Total net deviation = 29 × 23 = +667 runs.

Change in overall average = 667 ÷ 33 matches ≈ +20.21.

Combined average = Base average + Net change = 14 + 20.21 = 34.21.

**∴ The correct answer is 34.21.**
